heard: A blue asteroid is currently fizzing like sodium and water. In 1983, astronomers linked asteroid 3200 Phaethon to the Gemini meteor shower. Astronomers long believed this rock comet was a dead husk shedding dust. Its extreme orbit crosses the paths of Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. It divies within 13 million miles of the sun, hitting 1,400 degrees. But data from the SOHO spacecraft proved its tail contains no dust. The solid rock is actually outgassing sodium vapor like a boiling kettle. Sodium gas alone cannot explain the massive debris Cloud Earth hits every December. This bizarre mystery is why scientists keep chasing this giant blue rock.
